title: Join independently authorized existing Incident-Case relations and Investigate Case status
goal: Complete Class-0 CAP-CMD-106 existing linked Case source projection by composing independent Shared Object Linking and Investigate Case source owners for one selected Command Incident, without inferred grants, writes or synthetic relationships.
invariants: Command only consumes existing authorized Incident→Case references; Shared link owner and Investigate Case owner retain independent permissions and data authority.
One selected Incident Class-0 existing route only; no link create/open navigation, no inferred Case access from Incident, no unauthorized status or provenance.
Git base PR #177 is source ancestry only; canonical parent E10-CMD-106 is distinct.
security_properties: Shared authorizes each returned relation and Investigate separately authorizes every returned Case in identical principal/tenant/environment scope.
Malformed/duplicate/>16 link refs rejected before contacting Investigate; denied/absent Case omitted indistinguishably; cross-scope or invalid status aborts without partial output.
If any source errors the existing Command HTTP route returns generic 503; nil provider means unknown not empty. No raw source content or client-sourced ACLs.

migration.rationale: Additive host-side authorized source composition; existing HTTP/HTML interfaces unchanged.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional LinkedCaseOwnerJoin and host wiring; retain #177 projection, same route and source contracts.

inputs: CAP-CMD-106 §§5,8-11,15-19,21,25, OPEN-013 and Shared Object Linking/Case owner rules.
Parent PR #177 SHA 18ce1473c715e082ef7c0931e91cfb7deb94a08b, command-work-queue-runtime+engineering-kernel success, still draft/L2 not accepted.
outputs: One narrow source-join implementation of existing LinkedCasesOwner interface that retrieves authorized relation cohort then individually authorized Case statuses with explicit same-scope checks.
Behavioral tests via current Work Queue GET and hostile/denied/missing source fixtures; no production host adapter claimed.
acceptance_tests: Current selected authorized Incident requests Shared links once, then each Investigate Case independently; authorized visible Cases appear and denied Case is omitted.
No calls for unselected, Task, denied/foreign Case; >16/duplicate/invalid relations fail before any Case source lookup; cross-tenant/environment/ID/status return generic error with no metadata.
One Case source failing after previous succeeds cannot emit a partial Command HTTP response; unknown versus empty semantics preserved.
Go/Node command-work-queue-runtime and mandatory engineering-kernel security checks PASS on exact GitHub HEAD.

performance_budget.rationale: One owner read for existing selected Incident and <=16 individual Case owner reads; no source calls on unselected work items.
metrics: At most one Shared link read and 16 individual Investigate Case reads per selected authorized Incident
No second full Work Queue scan or new route

definition_of_ready: Existing #177 selected Incident and optional LinkedCasesOwner source interface are code-implemented and exact HEAD functional/engineering CI green; no accepted production host adapter exists.
OPEN-013 blocks Class-2 creation/link mutation only, not Class-0 join of existing independently readable links/Cases.
One bounded Command Work Queue read-only context, no migration and no new security authority or third-party dependency.
definition_of_done: Published first-party source join with independent ACL source contracts and fail-closed integration tests proven on CI exact SHA.
L2 independent and product acceptance remain separate; upstream PR stack remains draft/nonmerged, so no production claim.
